new;note:the NewSmall call of the small-block metadata helper (old line 285) as its own row
new;note:names the [load skip_ffff] golden line of flashfs_roots.txt (N2): a slot whose relative block reads 0xFFFF is skipped whatever its name and the slots after it load (a.bin@0x60,c.bin@0x62)

new;note:names the [load drop_compact] golden line of flashfs_roots.txt (N2): deleted (0x05), erased (0xFF), nameless and small-block cluster-0 entries drop; d.bin from the second directory page takes slot 1 and re-serializing writes slots 0=a.bin 1=d.bin with every later slot zero

new;note:names the [load big_relative_zero] golden line of flashfs_roots.txt (N2): on big block relative cluster 0 is the base 0xAE0, a valid block, so the entry is kept (zero.bin@0xAE0) where small block drops it

new;note:names the [load link_past_map] golden line of flashfs_roots.txt (N2): a table link of 0x400 on a 0x400-cluster map fails Malformed with the exact message "FlashFS cluster 0x60 links past the map to 0x400"

new;note:names the [load flagged_link_past_map] golden line of flashfs_roots.txt (N2): a link carrying the 0x8000 bit is range-checked on its low 15 bits: 0x8400 fails Malformed as "... links past the map to 0x400"

new;note:names the [load file_past_map] golden line of flashfs_roots.txt (N2): a valid entry starting past the map fails Malformed with the exact message "FlashFS file 'far.bin' starts past the map at 0x400"
new;note:names the [load dropped_past_map] golden line of flashfs_roots.txt (N2): a deleted (0x05) entry is dropped before the map check, so its out-of-range block loads ok with an empty directory
new;note:names the [load short_root] golden line of flashfs_roots.txt (N2): a root block past the image fails Truncated, "FlashFS root cluster 0x400 reads 0x0 bytes"

new;note:names the [load short_emmc_root] golden line of flashfs_roots.txt (N2): a 0x6000-byte image is taken as eMMC and its root cluster 1 runs off the end: Truncated, and the message says 0x0 bytes read because read_clean is all or nothing, although 0x2000 bytes of the cluster are in the image

new;note:names the [emmc] reload line (flashfs_roots.txt:51, version=0x0) (N2): eMMC has no spare, so the version save() stamps into root metadata is written nowhere and a filesystem formatted as version 3 reloads as version 0 (pinned as today; looks like a lost version)

new;note:names the identical [small] and [newsmall] root sha1 (flashfs_roots.txt:9 and :19) (N2): the same files on Small v7 and NewSmall v9 serialize to the same root bytes while the 16 MB images differ

new;note:names the [big_larger] base=0x2E0 and big_fs_size=0x6010 (N2): set_larger_filesystem(true) moves the first file from 0xAE0 to 0x2E0, the root states it at relative block 0, and the root spare carries fs_size 0x6010 instead of 0x2006
